scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace app run typecheck && npm --workspace @rei/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace @rei/shared test && npm --workspace app test && npm --prefix functions test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-rei --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix functions run test:rules"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-rei
scripts.deploy: npm run build:images && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy
